discussion_comments.comment_body: Good catch — fixed in 3d01681b. The `logs` action now forwards `--context` (and keeps `--output`) from `optsWithGlobals()` into `runLogsCommand`, so `getBaseUrl({ context })` sees the user's active context instead of always getting `undefined`.
flake.nix, devbox.json, and associated lock files are canonical in the root. Functionality of the package manager/development shim will break otherwise.
